title: H-composite Cheon BSGS: production-width key census with derived kappa_w, unfiltered ratio ranges, two-scale coverage and a seed-coin gap construction

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 G1 auxiliary-powers inputs T=A_1=[s]P0 and A_d=[s^d mod r]P0 with d=2^20, uniform nonzero s, and every integer n>=2^20. ORDER STRUCTURE (carried, accepted as internally consistent): r-1=2^32*u with u odd, m=(r-1)/2^20 has v2(m)=12, 6|m and m COMPOSITE; H={x:x^m=1} is the d-th-power subgroup, cyclic of order m (index d), mu6 subset H; gcd(d,m)=2^12 so no inverse of d mod m is used; v=s^d lies in H and determines s up to the d-element kernel; recovery is one 2-Sylow d-th-root plus the 2^20-candidate scan of [s*zeta^j]P0 against T, a ledger row. KEY COLLISIONS: both lists are H-members and the giant list carries v=s^d, uniform on H because x->x^d is exactly d-to-1. With N(k)=|{h in H : key_w([h]P0)=k}| and D_w=2^(w-1), the challenge-space expectation is the identity E[#collisions]=P_all*sum_k (N(k)/m)^2=P_all*kappa_w/D_w with kappa_w=D_w*sum_k(N(k)/m)^2=1+D_w*sum_k(N(k)-m/D_w)^2/m^2>=1, no independence assumed. v2(m)=12 forces m mod 2^(w-1)=2^12*(u mod 2^(w-13))!=0 for every w>=14, so exact 2^-(w-1) uniformity is IMPOSSIBLE and kappa_w>1 strictly; the smallest excess over all partitions is s(D-s)/m^2=2^-137.77 at w=168. The width law follows from uniform-hash dispersion of the multiplicity (the mu6 orbit gives 6 H-elements per key, hence m/6 effective draws): kappa_w=1+6*2^(w-1)/m, i.e. 1+2^-65.272 at w=168. MEASURED: exact cross-side counts at w=10..30 (21 widths) on the challenge-faithful object at 2^16 records/side and 3 challenges, plus 2^12 records/side and 6 challenges; observed/(pairs/2^(w-1)) is 1.00005, 1.00023, 1.00274, 1.00749, 1.00391, 0.96354, 0.92188, 0.95833, 0.95833, 1.04167 at w=10,14,18,22,25,26,27,28,29,30, every deviation within 1/sqrt(predicted) of the model value 1.000000, with the within-side multiplicity histogram shipped per width. The charge is the widest measured envelope: kappa=1.231=1+max ucb_excess over cells with predicted>=256, deliberately 2^64 above the model value, so E[#bad]=1.231*N^2/2^167=2^64.6005 and the probability that candidate work exceeds the charged 2^104 instructions is at most 2^-19.399 by Markov, each surviving candidate charged 2^20 instructions under a 2^84 candidate cap. RATIO RANGES OVER ALL CELLS, no predicted>=16 filter: faithful 0.833333-1.333333 over 37 cells; control 0.0-0.992889 over 16 cells; the extremes sit at cells with 4 and 1 predicted collisions where the Poisson sd is 50-100 percent; the predicted>=16 view is a disclosed secondary row (0.921875-1.041667) and is never charged. A band-limited H-prime control at d=2^4 on the production curve (4096 records/side, widths 10-24) matches the uniform-H' curve within noise. COVERAGE: success=E[C_distinct]/m with K_cand=6N^2 candidate occurrences v=x/(u x'); exp(-K) is used only as the design target at the design point with K_eff diagonal-corrected, and NO claim is made that linearity of expectation yields an occupancy law. The grid uses 8 bases per side (v19 used 4) at d in {8,64} on two fields, with list sizes and field size both doubled between scales so K_cand and the pool:walk geometry are preserved; the measured residuals |rowB|=(pred_eff-D)/m are 0.002480 and 0.000511 at d=8 (K=0.5012, 0.5013) and 0.007856, 0.002100 at d=64 (K=1.687, not at the design point and NOT charged). The charge is the declared statistic |rowB| ONCE at the production design point as an exact Fraction, 0.00247964; v19's additive maxA+maxB double-counted the diagonal already inside K_eff, and maxA ships as a disclosed diagnostic 0.00762195. |rowB| falls at both indices across the scales (ratios 0.206, 0.267) and that stability table is the entire direction claim, with no m-law and no cross-scale extrapolation. GAP, AS A COIN: the walk-band start is a seed, the construction verifies max gap <= 2^7.7*mu on the drawn list and re-draws on violation, so the deployed list satisfies the condition by construction and the 2^-40 modelling allowance is deleted; over 128 independent seeds (two scales x 64, disjoint seed-derived bands) the max/mean ratio is at most 10.732 and 10.464, KS pass 0.984 and 1.000, and 0 seeds exceed the production bound 2^7.7=208, a 2^4.276 margin; with the rule-of-three bound q<=3/128 and 10 draws the success debit is q^10=2^-54.150 and the expected 1.024 draws cost 2^97.782 instructions, a new gap_retry ledger row that is 2^-19 of the total. ROUTING: loads are charged at the MEASURED max/mean ratio 2.25 (largest fixture mean; the two rows at mean<=1 are disclosed and not charged because a max load cannot be below 1) instead of a uniform-occupancy formula, and prefix pairs at the measured 1.120, giving 2^84.47 against the 2^95 run cap, a 10.53-bit margin with the measured factor applied; the cap-abort event is the same seed-coin re-draw with probability 2^-54.150. RECORD AND SUCCESS: keymod.py is the single key rule (even member of y,p-y truncated to 168 bits, image 2^167) and the 48-byte record is 3 key limbs, side and a 128-bit position, 297 payload bits, no scalar; reconstruction is itemised at 39404 instructions. Success after every debit is 0.399504-0.00247964-0.00000145-2^-54.150=0.397023>=39/100, conditional on H3occ-scale (the declared residual bound), H3key (the width law, verified where measurable and charged at the widest tested envelope) and H3gap (the seed-coin construction), each with a measured fit and a disclosed limit. Work is 2*N*2238 instructions for the two walks plus chain tables, per-node fixed work, H-prime supply, the walk list, run-pair cap, the 2^84-candidate reconstruction cap, root extraction, the T-scan and the gap-retry row. Total W=2^116.812770 (2000-instruction units) < claim 116.8132 < gate 116.8271. Peak memory 2^123.3 B, no advice, preprocessing inside the total. CERTIFICATE SCOPE: the certificate recomputes this ledger and the declared formulas from raw evidence; it does not independently establish production resource bounds, run the production attack, or verify the premises.
